items.name: SnoCo Veteran's Weekend A 2022
items.information: This competition is part of a series with [SnoCo Veteran's Weekend B 2022](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/SnoCoVeteransWeekendB2022). Competitors are allowed to only compete in 1 competition. You can see more information on the [Competition Series](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/SnoCoVeteransWeekendA2022#22394-competition-series) tab. This is an official World Cube Association competition. Therefore, all competitors must be familiar with the [WCA Regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/). If you are new to competing, please refer to the [Competitor Responsibilities](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/SnoCoVeteransWeekendA2022#21405-please-read-competitor-responsibilities) tab. [![Image description](https://www.pnwcubing.com/uploads/1/9/8/7/19877007/published/pnwcubing-transparent-01.png?1639634180)](https://www.facebook.com/groups/159856602085)

items.name: UBC Odd Weekend 2022

venue.name: [AMS Student Nest, UBC](https://www.nestcatering.com/our-space/unique-venues/the-great-hall/)
venue.details: The competition will be held in Great Hall North on the 2nd Floor of the Nest.

items.information: Please **review all of the tabs listed on this website**. Masks are optional and we will not be checking vaccination status. **Please be aware that there is a possibility that we will need to increase safety precautions.** An email will be sent out to registered competitors about significant changes if any are needed. Spectators can attend for free. Due to venue capacity, we ask that competitors bring a maximum of 1 guest each. Finally, please note that we may run ahead of or behind schedule - for events after lunch on both days, **please be ready at least 30 minutes in advance** just in case. You only need to show up for the events you are competing in (and the new competitor tutorial if you are a new competitor).
